purpose: Expand the overall meaning and contextual deeper explanation of the first 50 slokas for a general reader, while preserving devotional focus on Lalita.
current_update_scope: Verse-level overall and deeper panels only; not a new rewrite of all individual divine-name explanations.
expanded_explanation_style: A fuller overall meaning followed by two connected paragraphs explaining the imagery, story or philosophical context. Each verse is individually written; no theme rotation or reusable filler.
expanded_editorial_status: Original English and Kannada translations and explanations informed by the Sanskrit and devotional commentary. Editorial interpretation, not verbatim reproduction or scholarly certification.
reference_metadata: Retained in the repository; not repeated in reading panels at the user's request.
generic_reflections: Remain withdrawn from rendering and search, not deleted from the repository.
preserved: Search and navigation code in app.js

verification.browser_fixture_tests: Six offline Chromium integration scenarios passed: 1280px and 390px rendering, language rerender, expanded/base fetch failures, duplicate/missing expanded entries. Checked overall-first order, no optional/source links, preserved component rows and audio elements, no horizontal overflow, replacement merge and suppression of generic text.
verification.browser_test_scope: Simulated DOM and fetch fixtures with synthetic content; not a live deployment or a claim that all final text was visually proofread.
verification.runtime_validation: All five final data files must provide exactly 50 unique bilingual verse entries, non-empty overall meanings, distinct deeper explanations of at least 75 English words and two paragraphs in both languages. Invalid expanded data falls back safely without hiding the base reviewed collection.
